text.en:
There is appropriated out of any Stands in the Philippine Treasury, not otherwise appropriated,
the sum of ten million pesos to be emended by the Civilian Emergency Administration, subject to the approval
of the President of the Philippines, for the protection, defense, aid welfare of the civil population of the
Philippines.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 7, 1941.
